name: gam3stack
description: gam3stack: MIT-licensed game development kits and skills for coding agents. One plugin per engine.

plugins.name: unreal
plugins.description: Unreal Engine: drive the editor from the shell, build worlds with Landscape and PCG, compile and capture unattended. Kits you copy into the project, skills, /unreal:* commands, local MCP server.

plugins.name: unity
plugins.description: Unity: run the editor in batch mode, read compile errors, run tests, build terrain from data and capture screenshots. Kits you copy into the project, skills, /unity:* commands, local MCP server.
